[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Mahmoud and Ehab and the MEX** [CF 862A · Mahmoud and Ehab and the MEX](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/862/A){rating="1000"}

$\operatorname{MEX} = x$ says two independent things: every value $0..x-1$ is present, and $x$ is absent. Mark which of $0..x$ occur in a presence table; each unmarked value below $x$ costs one add, and a marked $x$ costs one erase. Nothing above $x$ matters.
